train_EQACNNPretrainTrainer: run the EQACNNPretrainTrainer to pretrain a MultitaskCNN encoder-decoder model for EmbodiedQA feature extraction
eval_EQACNNPretrainTrainer_checkpoint: evaluate a saved EQACNNPretrainTrainer checkpoint on the validation set and log loss metrics to TensorBoard
save_EQACNNPretrainTrainer_results: save RGB reconstruction, segmentation, and depth prediction results from the EQACNNPretrainTrainer evaluation to disk
make_EQACNNPretrainTrainer_results_dir: create output directories for RGB, segmentation, and depth results before running EQACNNPretrainTrainer evaluation
review_EQACNNPretrainTrainer_class: review the EQACNNPretrainTrainer class which implements multitask CNN pretraining with segmentation, autoencoder, and depth reconstruction losses
